title: Starship launches on 15th test, calls off booster catch
html:
Updated 6:40 a.m. Eastern Nov. 14 with Super Heavy booster divert details.

Jeff Foust writes about space policy, commercial space, and related topics for SpaceNews. He earned a Ph.D. in planetary sciences from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and a bachelor’s degree with honors in geophysics and planetary science... More by Jeff Foust
summary: Flight 15's Super Heavy diverted after a guidance issue and was destroyed before splashdown.
